privacy.metaDesc: What data is generated when you visit this website.
privacy.notice: This information describes the technology actually in place. A complete, legally reviewed statement including the address of the controller is still outstanding.
privacy.hosting: The website is delivered as static files via GitHub Pages. When the site is accessed, GitHub processes technically necessary connection data such as the IP address. I have no influence over this processing beyond the configuration.
privacy.notTitle: What this website does not do
privacy.not1: No cookies, no tracking, no analytics or marketing services.
privacy.not2: No externally loaded fonts or third-party scripts.
privacy.not3: No contact form. An email is processed by your email provider and mine.
privacy.translation1: The languages in the language selection are pre-translated and delivered as static files. No data is sent to third parties in the process.
privacy.translation2: Only if you actively trigger a live translation under “More languages” is the visible text of the current page sent to a translation service, which translates it using Anthropic's Claude API. In addition, the operator of the service processes technically necessary connection data such as the IP address. No cookies are set and no data is stored permanently. Without your trigger, no request takes place.
privacy.theme: If you switch on the dark theme, your browser remembers this choice in local storage (localStorage) so that it applies on your next visit. The entry stays on your device, is not sent to a server, and can be deleted via the browser settings.
privacy.private: The area protected by passkey is a separate application with its own privacy policy. This public website does not transmit any data there.
